timeframes.description: Timeframes to capture, ordered fine → coarse. Default ["15m","1h","4h","1D"].

max_images.description: Image budget (default 4) — extra timeframes are reported, not captured.

include_numeric_context.description: Attach per-timeframe numbers (default true). Turn off only for a pure visual look.

inline_base64.description: Also repeat raw base64 inside the JSON block (default false — images already arrive as inline image blocks).

fresh.description: Bypass the ~12s snapshot cache and force a fresh render.
